# GIFT City Funds

> Plain-English educational guide to GIFT City (IFSC) mutual funds, AIFs and PMS structures for NRIs, OCIs and resident Indians. Written by Anup Vatyani, AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN 106715). Informational only; not investment, tax or legal advice.

## Guides

- [What Is GIFT City & IFSC?](https://giftcityfunds.in/what-is-gift-city): India's international financial services centre and its regulator, IFSCA.
- [GIFT City Fund Categories](https://giftcityfunds.in/funds-explained): Mutual Fund FoFs, AIFs, PMS and feeder funds compared.
- [Who GIFT City Funds Are For](https://giftcityfunds.in/who-its-for): Fit for NRIs, OCIs and resident Indians.
- [GIFT City Funds for US-Based NRIs](https://giftcityfunds.in/us-based-nris): PFIC, US tax reporting and what to check.
- [Regulation and Taxation](https://giftcityfunds.in/taxation): IFSCA oversight, Section 10(4D), LRS and TCS.
- [How to Invest](https://giftcityfunds.in/how-to-invest): Step-by-step process from eligibility and KYC to allotment.
- [GIFT City Funds vs Regular Mutual Funds](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-vs-mutual-funds): Regulator, currency, minimums, eligibility and tax compared.
- [Risks of GIFT City Funds](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-risks): Market, currency, liquidity, tax and regulatory risks.
- [GIFT City Funds for NRIs by Country](https://giftcityfunds.in/gift-city-funds-nri-tax-by-country): Home-country rules to check in the UAE, UK, US, Canada and Singapore.
- [FAQs](https://giftcityfunds.in/faqs): Short answers to common questions.

## Insights articles

- [How to Open a GIFT City Bank Account (IFSC Banking Unit)](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/how-to-open-gift-city-bank-account): Who can open one, documents, funding and what to compare.
- [GIFT City Fixed Deposits vs NRE and FCNR Deposits](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/gift-city-fd-vs-nre-fcnr): Currency, tenure, Indian tax on interest and returning to India.
- [Returning to India? What Happens to Your GIFT City Investments](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/returning-to-india-gift-city-investments): RNOR status, FEMA holdings rules, LRS for new money, checklist.
- [How NRIs Can Invest in GIFT City Funds: A Step-by-Step Overview](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/nri-step-by-step): A step-by-step walkthrough of how NRIs and OCIs actually invest in GIFT City IFSC funds, from eligibility and KYC to remittance and unit allotment.
- [LRS, TCS and GIFT City: What Resident Indian Investors Should Know](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/lrs-tcs-gift-city): How the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) and Tax Collected at Source (TCS) apply when a Resident Indian invests in a GIFT City fund via the Overseas Portfolio Investment route.
- [AIF vs PMS vs Mutual Fund FoF: Choosing a GIFT City Structure](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/aif-vs-pms-vs-fof): A side-by-side comparison of the three main GIFT City fund structures — AIF, PMS and Mutual Fund FoF — to help you choose the right one for your ticket size and goals.
- [IFSCA vs SEBI: Who Actually Regulates Your GIFT City Fund](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/ifsca-vs-sebi): A clear explanation of how IFSCA regulates GIFT City IFSC funds, how that differs from SEBI's role for domestic Indian mutual funds, and what it means for investor protection.
- [GIFT City Fund vs NRE/NRO Investing: A Straight Comparison](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/gift-city-vs-nre-nro): How investing through a GIFT City fund compares with the traditional NRE and NRO account route for NRIs — currency, repatriation, tax and structure differences explained.
- [GIFT City vs Direct Foreign Investment: What Actually Changes for an NRI](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/gift-city-vs-direct-foreign): What changes when an NRI invests through a GIFT City IFSC fund instead of investing directly in a foreign brokerage account or offshore fund.
- [Ten Questions NRIs Actually Ask About GIFT City Funds](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/ten-questions-nris-ask): Ten plain-English answers to the questions NRIs most commonly ask before investing in a GIFT City IFSC fund.
- [PFIC Explained: Why It Matters for Every US-Based NRI Investor](https://giftcityfunds.in/insights/pfic-explained): A plain-English explanation of PFIC status, why it applies to many foreign funds, and why GIFT City fund structure matters for US-based NRIs and US persons.
